summary: Temporary danger area EGD699A around Loch Leven, 2 nautical mile radius, surface to 5,000 ft above sea level.
text:
TEMPORARY DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD699A INSTALLED WI A 2NM RADIUS 
CIRCLE CENTRED ON 5611N 00320W PSN LOCH LEVEN. SAR OPS ON, NO 
RESTRICTIONS ON FREQUENCY. TO ENSURE SAFETY AND AVOID INTERFERENCE 
WITH CTL AND SAR ACTIVITIES, PILOTS ARE REQ NOT TO FLY IN OR NEAR 
THE AREA WO PERMISSION OF THE EMERG CONTROLLING AUTHORITY VIA TEL 
03443 820800. ACTION MAY BE TAKEN TO IMPOSE RESTRICTIONS OF FLYING 
REGULATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAVIGATION ORDER 2016. ATC 
UNITS CLOSE TO THE INCIDENT AREA ARE REQ TO ADVISE ACFT ON THEIR 
FREQ OF THE CONTENTS OF THIS NOTAM.
